title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The incident title indicates that a lawyer in Minnesota was suspended in connection with submitting fake case citations attributed to AI-generated output. This belongs to a well-documented failure mode in which a generative AI system produces plausible-looking but fabricated legal citations, and a human user submits those citations in a legal proceeding without independently verifying them. The failure occurs at the point of human use, after the model's output leaves the system, meaning the check that would have caught it, manual verification of each cited case against an authoritative legal database, was either skipped or inadequate.

What is not established is any detail about the specific AI tool used, the cases or proceedings involved, the precise disciplinary findings, or the full sequence of events, because the underlying article text was not available and only the headline and publication metadata are known.
